question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 2.
solution:
The correct answer is '**on**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The appropriate option to fill in blank no. 2: **on**.
 
• The sentence structure discussing posters indicates they are utilized ***"to promote a brand or pass on important information."***
 
• Here, **"pass on"** implies that posters serve as a medium through which **important information is communicated or transferred to the audience.**
 
• It highlights the role of posters as a channel or platform for conveying crucial details, emphasizing that the posters themselves are the means by which this information is transmitted.
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 2.**

 

**Correct Sequence:__** *Posters are **used** to promote a brand or pass **on** important information. They can be used for (3) __________ purposes ranging from telling people to be cautious as the floor is wet, to informing them about an upcoming sale or event. They usually include a picture (4) __________ very few words. A suitable (5) __________ makes a poster effective and memorable.*
